meta.scope: Men's and women's overall standings after round five, 2022–2026. Separate from PBA profile seasons and U.S. Amateur stepladder results.
meta.identity: Names are matched within division after punctuation, case and accent normalization. Unverified aliases or name changes remain separate records; no global member IDs are supplied.
meta.average: Total scratch pins / 30, only after all 30 positive game scores in the five daily sheets sum to the overall total. Partial, absent or ambiguous scores withhold the average; they do not become zero.
meta.clock: First complete 30-game entry in this 2022–2026 snapshot, not a bowler's debut or first professional year.
meta.refresh: Bundled official-results snapshot; run the USBC builder to refresh. No live lookup or league-average data.
